projects.title: Inventory Optimization Using EOQ & Demand Forecasting
projects.description: Built demand forecasting models in Python and Excel for 50+ SKUs, optimizing Economic Order Quantity (EOQ) and reorder point calculations to improve replenishment accuracy. Decreased excess inventory by 22%, improved inventory turnover by 15%, and saved $8K annually in carrying costs.

projects.title: Workflow Inspection & Defect Analysis System
projects.description: Designed inspection workflows with root cause analysis frameworks (5 Whys, Fishbone) across 3 production lines, standardizing quality control procedures. Lowered quality escapes by 30% and decreased customer complaints by 20%.
